metadata.name: p1
metadata.description: draft passcode field (current/first). Non-secret draft; cleared after each action.

metadata.name: p1b
metadata.description: draft passcode field for the import-file flow.

metadata.name: imp
metadata.description: draft import-blob field (pasted/loaded keystore file contents).

metadata.name: msg
metadata.description: the last action's result/status message shown under the form.

metadata.name: phrase
metadata.description: the revealed recovery phrase (only after Create / Show recovery phrase).

metadata.name: profileui
metadata.description: (status, name, identity, p1, p2, nm, imp, msg, phrase) -> a PURE profile-window vnode. Renders create / unlock+import / unlocked (name, reshuffle, export, recovery-phrase, change-passcode, lock) by keystore.status.

metadata.name: profilewin
metadata.description: () GENESIS: the gen-2 profile WINDOW (self-mounting wframe over (profileui …)). The app:profileapp launcher calls it.

metadata.name: profile.create
metadata.description: read p1/p2/nm drafts -> keystore.create (passcodes must match) -> show the recovery phrase.

metadata.name: profile.reshuffle
metadata.description: keystore.reshuffle (new keypair; old kept in history).

metadata.name: profile.import
metadata.description: read imp + p1b/p1 -> keystore.import (load a keystore file, the file:// path).

metadata.name: profile.importfile
metadata.description: (<input type=file> change) read the chosen file's text into the import draft.

metadata.name: profile.export
metadata.description: keystore.export -> trigger a browser download of plastron-identity.kc (sealed under the passcode).
